verdict.rationale: Crawl4AI is an open-source, self-hosted crawling library with no forced API keys or hosted API service (crawl4ai-docs-4); there is no vendor-enforced API-key rate limit to document, and community notes explicitly say rate limiting is left to the user to implement (crawl4ai-comm-3). This story presumes a hosted API-key SaaS model, which is a wrong axis for a self-hosted library.
